items.title: Viewer popups open as real windows
items.text: Links that open in a new tab/window from a website in a viewer pane now open as their own proper window that honors the requested size, instead of getting trapped or mis-sized in the pane.

items.title: Address-bar copy & paste
items.text: Copy and paste now work correctly in the viewer's address field.

items.title: Smoother feedback composer
items.text: The worktree-feedback composer sits above the content correctly, reflows cleanly as the pane shrinks, and clipboard shortcuts work as expected.

items.title: Quieter, correct pane navigation
items.text: Arrow-key navigation no longer beeps at or skips over viewer panes.
